evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

observations.why: Establishes a prospective rule governing all future deployment instances rather than an actualized past event.

evidence.quote:
We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter

observations.why: Recalls specific, actual occurrences from the previous quarter as justification.

evidence.quote: Gate**: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Records the general policy requirement as an established structured fact.

evidence.quote: Scope**: applies to staging and production

observations.why: Defines the ongoing scope of application for the gate.
States the specific individual currently assigned ownership of the gate.
